pages.title: Removed: Sword Forge
pages.text: $(bold)The Sword Forge$() was once a core functional block of this mod.$(br2)Players needed to feed it $(l)Tamahagane$(), $(l)Coolant$(), $(l)Charcoal$(), and $(l)Whetstone$(), then wait for a period of time to receive a random Touken Danshi.$(br2)However, during testing, its waiting mechanic did not work out as I had envisioned, resulting in frequent item duplication exploits. Unable to find an elegant fix, I had no choice but to remove it.
$(bold)If you miss this sense of waiting ritual, please let me know through feedback channels — perhaps it will return in a safer form in a future update.
